protocol.scope:
Bounded-observer development and separately frozen mixed-sensitivity replay.

Development reuses the published failure matrix. The holdout contains new
perturbation combinations and noise seeds, fixed before replay. It is simulator
generalization only; the glyph writers and synthetic acceptance are not new
human validation data. Results count supervisor completion and retrospectively
checked true tracking separately, so observer optimism cannot hide a failure.
protocol.primary_endpoint: whole accepted suffix completed AND actual stage tracking error <=150um and radius <=3mm at every simulated sample

dataset.name: uji2
dataset.citation: Prat F, Castro MJ, Llorens D, Marzal A, Vilar JM. UJI Pen Characters (Version 2). UCI Machine Learning Repository, 2008. doi:10.24432/C5FG8S

preflight.evidence: CALCULATION: offline accepted-geometry preflight, proposed body repositioning; no physical execution

bounds.scope: CALC: reference within assumed motion/load/slew envelope; no plant or ink validation
CALC: reference within assumed motion/load/slew envelope; no plant or ink validation

preflight.repositioning: The person or an external grounded actuator must supply these pen-up body translations; an internal stage cannot supply them indefinitely.
preflight.execution: Every letter requires fresh anchored observations and CompletionExecutor; this file commands no motor.
preflight.ink: Only future suffix strokes or a separately placed rewrite. Existing ink is untouched.

gain_matched_path_feedforward.evidence: SIMULATION: generic planar stage, real glyph shape only; no hardware or human validation
gain_matched_path_feedforward.command_limits: Acceleration vector <=2m/s² and vector slew <=300m/s³; true acceleration can violate these under unmodelled loads or plant mismatch. Certificate stopping reserve requires demonstrated plant authority, not merely command clipping.

bounded_observer.evidence:
Causal, bounded-disturbance feedback for explicitly accepted future ink.

This is an engineering prototype for the generic planar stage, not the Rev K
mechanism. Position measurements carry their acquisition timestamps. A delayed
update is replayed through already applied, measured coil currents to estimate
the present state. The disturbance state has a force cap; no target-error
integrator can wind up during current saturation. Position-noise and process
covariance assumptions are fixed by ObserverDesign, not read from plant truth.

ink_accounting.discretization: Contact durations use 0.5ms samples; length sums only adjacent ink samples. Full-plan denominators include unexecuted letters.

limitations: generic planar stage only; not a concrete Rev K or five-bar validation
exact anchored body position and rigid known attitude
ideal timestamp and measured-current access
filter covariance assumptions do not prove estimation error bounds
observer force cap is a design assumption
recovery force is separately bounded at40mN and10N/s, not mislabelled as a desired trajectory acceleration
retrospective true tracking-tube check is evaluation only, never a controller input
reference jerk limits do not guarantee actual jerk under unknown friction or force mismatch
